keyLimits.en: Annual sales capped at $10k, zero transaction fees, unlimited products
Annual sales capped at $50k, removes Sellfy branding, 10,000 email marketing credits
Annual sales capped at $200k, priority support, 50,000 email marketing credits, 20GB file size limit

cautions.en: Each plan has an annual sales cap; exceeding it triggers a required upgrade or 2% overage fees, on top of standard PayPal/Stripe processing fees (2.9% + 30 cents).

capabilities.en: Sells digital products, physical goods, subscriptions, and print-on-demand items from one storefront
Built-in email marketing with coupon codes and customer reviews
Store customization with themes and custom domain support

limitations.en: No permanent free plan, only a 14-day trial
Annual sales are capped per plan, requiring an upgrade once a store grows past the tier's cap

reason.en: Direct competitor for selling digital products with a simpler storefront
Self-hosted e-commerce alternative for a full online store
Larger e-commerce platform competitor with broader product scope

unknowns: 30-day money-back guarantee terms and exclusions not detailed
Exact overage fee mechanics beyond the stated 2% figure not fully specified
